messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Observed sudden increase in inference p95 and connection queue depth on hosted API (us-west-2). Auto-threshold triggered. Incident INF-2026-342 created.

pagerduty: Page delivered to on-call: sarah-nguyen

sarah-nguyen: I'm on-call, looking. Can someone share the top-line customer impact?

alex-ramos: p95 token latency for text-generation up from ~180ms to ~2s for a subset of streaming requests. Non-streaming endpoints also rising but less. GPU utilization spiked to 98% on pool gw-a* nodes.

maria_lee: OBS logs show many streaming connections stuck in stalled reads >30s. KV cache hits normal. Suspect clients waiting for SSE/chunked responses and causing backpressure.

kevin: TL;DR: streaming long-polls are holding worker slots. If we can drop streaming for heavy flows we should free capacity quickly.

sarah-nguyen: Proposal: temporarily disable streaming responses for hosted tier (all new requests) and shift traffic to non-streaming generation for 10-15m while we mitigate. Also raise short-term token rate limit for non-streaming to absorb conversions.

eng-runtime-bot: Runbook: Streaming Degrade -> https://runbooks.internal/streaming-degrade
Commands:
```
# flip feature flag for hosted API
./ops-toggle feature streaming_responses --scope hosted --state off --reason "INF-2026-342 emergency disable"
# increase per-route token limit for non-streaming
./ratectl set /v1/generate token_rate 1.5x --ttl 15m
```

sarah-nguyen: executing ops-toggle now. Will post when done. @cm-esc please prepare customer comms (banner + DM list)

cm-esc: On it. Drafting banner: "Transient degradation: streaming responses temporarily disabled to stabilize API. Non-streaming endpoints unaffected."

sarah-nguyen: ops-toggle returned SUCCESS. Streaming flag: OFF for hosted. Observability: shifting traffic to non-streaming routes.

alex-ramos: Immediate telemetry: queue depth dropping on gw-a* and p95 down from ~2s to ~400ms on non-streaming. Streaming connection count dropping by 87%.

kevin: Started traffic-shaping to prioritize short requests: applied token-based routing to reduce long-runner preemption.

maria_lee: Kicked off node drain on a few overloaded instances to rebalance long-running streams. No reconnect storm observed so far.

sarah-nguyen: Noting customer impact: some customers with streaming integrations will see responses arrive only after completion instead of streaming chunks. No data loss. CM preparing list for top-10 affected customers.

cm-esc: Sent DMs to top-10 customers (enterprise) and posted banner. Internal note: use "streaming disabled" tag in support triage.

eng-runtime-bot: Canary check: 2 of 3 canary regions passed. Observability shows error rates stable. Recommending 15m watch + gradual rollback once p95 stable <300ms for 5m.

kevin: Agree. Start 15m timer. If any spike in errors or customer reports, revert or route traffic to Dedicated.

sarah-nguyen: Handoff in 10m to @alex-ramos (next on-call). I'm staying until stability confirmed. Maria, keep an eye on the drain/evictions.

alex-ramos: ack. I'll continue monitoring and coordinate with infra if we need capacity bump.

maria_lee: Eviction rate normalized. No OOMs. GC metrics look ok.

cm-esc: Customers acknowledged banner, two asked ETA, provided 15m estimate and workaround (use non-streaming endpoint). No escalations.

sarah-nguyen: 15m passed. p95 steady ~260ms, queue depth nominal. Proceeding to re-enable streaming for hosted as a canary (10% first).

eng-runtime-bot: Re-enable command:
```
./ops-toggle feature streaming_responses --scope hosted --state on --rollout 10% --reason "INF-2026-342 rollback-candidate"
```

sarah-nguyen: Executed canary re-enable 10%. Monitoring.

alex-ramos: Telemetry looks good at 10%. Increasing to 50% after 3m if stable.

sarah-nguyen: 50% rollouts complete. No regressions. Rolling to 100% now.

eng-runtime-bot: Rollout finished: streaming_responses ON for hosted. Incident mitigation complete.

sarah-nguyen: Closing actions: 1) Investigate root cause of stuck streaming reads (likely client-side slow consumers or chunking edge case). 2) Add auto-degrade policy to detect high streaming connection stall and auto-shed without full disable. 3) Improve docs for customers on fallback to non-streaming endpoints. Assign to eng-runtime/infra.

kevin: Filing follow-up ticket INF-2026-342-FU with triage notes and initial hypotheses.

cm-esc: Sent follow-up comms to customers and support teams. Marking incident: mitigated, postmortem scheduled.

sarah-nguyen: Thanks team. Leaving notes in the incident tracker. Passing on-call to @alex-ramos. :white_check_mark:

alex-ramos: Taking over on-call. Watching for 30m. Ping me if anything
